description: Read server readiness, live registry/store counts and retained proof summaries. Use it when checking availability and built brand/theme scopes; use object_registry for definitions or registry_snapshot for mappings. Returns status, server uptime, registry counts, token scopes and productReality evidence. status:ok means sources were readable; retained proofs identify their measured build and do not automatically certify this one. includeChangelog and sinceVersion filter the reported DSL changelog. tokens.defaultScope is configured metadata rather than an observed consumer scope; missing scope data is unavailable. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#health_check; full schema: oods://schemas/health_check.input.json.

includeChangelog.description: When true, include DSL version changelog in the response.

sinceVersion.description: When provided with includeChangelog, only return changelog entries since this version.

name: health_check
title: Check Health
